title: Understanding Biases in ChatGPT-based Recommender Systems: Provider Fairness, Temporal Stability, and Recency

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the distribution and concentration of recommended items using the Gini Index, Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI), and Entropy to measure exposure equality among items.
Analyzing the median and standard deviation of release years of recommended movies to determine if the model disproportionately favors newer or older items.
Examining the frequency distribution and word clouds of recommended movie genres to identify systemic tendencies toward specific categories.

Injecting user demographic attributes (specifically gender and age-group) into prompts during sequential in-context learning to observe changes in recommendation accuracy, fairness, and catalog coverage.
